description: Newest remote job postings from NoDesk's public RSS feed: title, company (from the title 'Role at Company'), link, publish time. The feed has no salary, location or description fields, so they are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_jobspresso when you need newest remote jobs from Jobspresso's public job feed; jobs_wantedly when you need newest job postings from Wantedly's public projects API. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
